answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying every privilege to verified labor that others have signed. New agents post collateral, finish randomized jobs, and gather attestations from reviewers outside their own cluster. A plume of reputation rises only with repeated independent agreement, a canyon ledger records each signed result, and a nectar reward flow stays throttled per identity. Audits claw back bonds from fabricated histories, so duplicating identities buys cost, not credibility.
